notablePrerequisites: You control Forests and/or green creatures that can tap to produce at least {8}{G}{G}.
description:
Activate all Forests and mana-producing green creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {8}{G}{G}.
Cast Patron of the Orochi by paying {6}{G}{G}.
Patron of the Orochi enters the battlefield, triggering Cadric and Cloudstone Curio.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing not to return anything from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Cadric trigger, cauisng you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Patron of the Orochi with haste.
The Patron of the Orochi token enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, returning the nontoken Patron of the Orochi from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate the Patron of the Orochi token by tapping it, untapping all Forests and green creatures.
Activate all Forests and mana-producing green creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {8}{G}{G}.
Repeat.
